## Easy Windows download

[Download Codex-Meter-Windows.zip](https://github.com/rpg86x/codex-meter/releases/download/vVERSION/Codex-Meter-Windows.zip)

Extract the ZIP, then double-click **INSTALL.exe**. The ZIP contains the installer and `LEESMIJ.txt` with Dutch and English instructions.

To update: quit Codex Meter from the tray menu, run `INSTALL.exe` and use your existing installation folder. Do not uninstall first. Your language and Sync settings stay with the same Windows account.

GitHub's **Source code (zip)** is for developers. Choose **Codex-Meter-Windows.zip** to install the app.

- Windows x64; Node.js is not required.
- Source PC: Codex desktop app with ChatGPT sign-in. Sync receiver: no Codex installation required.
- Dutch and English interface options.
- System tray icon and shortcuts on your desktop and in the Start menu.

The installer is not digitally signed, so Windows may display an unknown-publisher warning. SHA256SUMS.txt contains the installer checksum.
